title: BTC loses reset support as open interest expands and ETH underperforms
hypothesis: After a NO_EDGE reset, a persistent BTC break below the predeclared 85,900 support combined with at least 2% contract-OI growth and simultaneous ETH deterioration should restore REVERSAL_RISK, but should not become an automatic short unless sell flow, breadth or liquidation evidence independently confirms.
mechanism: BTC traded about 2.38% below the prior reset snapshot and remained far below 85,900 across the accessible completed one-minute sequence, while OKX BTC contract OI increased about 5.04% from the reset snapshot. ETH fell about 4.10%, providing negative cross-asset confirmation. Positive but lower funding and a negative premium leave the direction of the new OI ambiguous; the state therefore indicates leverage-backed reversal risk rather than a proven downtrend.
exact_rule_or_model_spec: Paper-only state transition from the prior reset. Set REVERSAL_RISK = completed_15m_close < 85900 AND next_completed_15m_close < 85900 AND OI_contract_now/OI_contract_reset - 1 >= 0.02 AND BTC_price_now < BTC_price_reset AND ETH_price_now < ETH_price_reset. Set expected_trade_expression=NEUTRAL. Upgrade to TREND_DOWN or SHORT_BIAS only in paper shadow if BTC also breaks the rolling 24h low and at least one independent confirmation passes: taker_sell_ratio_5m >= rolling_30d_q67, breadth_positive_share_top50_5m <= rolling_30d_q33, ask_microprice_pressure_z <= -1, or long_liquidation_notional_5m >= rolling_30d_q90. Do not open, close, reverse, resize, delay, suppress or route a live order.
required_data: Point-in-time BTC and ETH perpetual prices and completed 15-minute candles
Prospectively timestamped BTC contract open interest with firstObservedAt and ingestedAt
Current and settled funding plus perpetual premium/index basis
Taker buy/sell flow, top-50 breadth, L2 depth, spread, microprice and liquidation stream
Prior reset snapshot, support level and state timestamp
Cross-exchange BTC and ETH price/OI observations when available
transaction_cost_implications: A reversal-risk reset may avoid chasing stale continuation, but a hard veto, forced exit or short can add spread, slippage, missed-rebound cost and funding exposure. Test unchanged-baseline, score-reset, same-side rotation, hard-veto shadow and confirmed-short shadow separately using actual fee tier, Q-sized book walk, funding, adverse markout and 1.5x/2x slippage stress.
expected_benefit: Reduce drawdown from retaining a neutral or continuation label after support failure with leverage expansion, while preserving trade frequency by using a confidence/state reset instead of an automatic directional trade.
risks: The move may be a temporary leverage build followed by a short squeeze. Contract OI is direction-ambiguous; lower positive funding and negative premium do not identify new longs. BTC had bounced above the 24-hour low at observation time, and only top-of-book depth was accessible. No verified taker, liquidation, broad-market breadth, cross-exchange or Polymarket probability-velocity confirmation was available, so TREND_DOWN is not established.
falsification_criteria: REJECT if the REVERSAL_RISK reset fails to improve matched-frequency net PnL, profit factor or maximum drawdown in both locked OOS periods; if benefit disappears under 1.5x costs; if retention falls below 98%; if price-only support failure performs equally well and OI plus ETH add no incremental value; if prospective point-in-time OI does not reproduce the relation; or if gains depend on fewer than five independent event clusters.
validation_plan: Use only observations satisfying usableAt<=decision_time. Develop thresholds on 2024-2025, validate unchanged on January-June 2026, and use July-September 2026 once as a locked test only where OI time semantics are verified. Freeze the transition and run at least 90 future paper days. Compare STALE_NO_EDGE, PRICE_ONLY_BREAK, PRICE_X_OI_REBUILD, PRICE_X_ETH, FULL_REVERSAL_RISK_RESET, HARD_VETO_SHADOW, CONFIRMED_SHORT_SHADOW and matched-frequency random controls. Report net PnL, profit factor, maximum drawdown, MAE/MFE, retention, trade count, capital utilization, implementation shortfall and 1.5x/2x cost sensitivity with day/event-block bootstrap.
minimum_sample: At least 200 reset states, 75 two-close support failures, 50 failures with OI growth of at least 2%, 50 with simultaneous ETH deterioration, 500 eligible baseline decisions, five independent event clusters and at least 90 prospective calendar days; extend until all counts are met.

primary_drivers: funding and premium do not confirm crowded-long capitulation

contradictions: BTC and ETH were below their 24-hour opens, but BTC had rebounded about 0.82% from the 24-hour low.
BTC contract OI increased materially while price fell, but positive low funding and negative premium do not reveal whether the new OI is long, short or hedged.
The accessible top-of-book snapshot showed more displayed bid than ask size, but a single-level snapshot is unstable and cannot outweigh the multi-hour support failure.
No verified taker-flow, liquidation, broad breadth, cross-exchange or Polymarket probability-change confirmation was available.
invalidation_triggers: Cancel REVERSAL_RISK if BTC completes two consecutive 15-minute closes above 85,900 while OI falls at least 1.5% from the current snapshot and ETH recovers.
Upgrade only to conditional TREND_UP if BTC recovers the original breakout area near 86,570, ETH confirms, and breadth, taker flow or microprice provides an independent positive signal.
Escalate toward TREND_DOWN only if BTC breaks the rolling 24-hour low near 83,500 with negative breadth and sell-flow or long-liquidation confirmation.
Keep NEUTRAL if BTC remains between the 24-hour low and 85,900 while funding, premium and flow evidence stay mixed.

polymarket_context.liquidity_spread_oi_volume_observations: No trustworthy point-in-time probability-velocity and market-quality series was available for this update.
polymarket_context.reliability_notes: Polymarket was excluded rather than treated as directional confirmation.

derivatives_context.observations: The prior packet's predeclared REVERSAL_RISK trigger is materially satisfied: price persisted below 85,900 and failed to reclaim while OI rose more than 2% from the reset snapshot. ETH weakened more than BTC. Funding and premium prevent treating this as a direct short without independent confirmation.

macro_news_context: No new official macro or regulatory catalyst was used. This is a derivatives and price-state transition; absent an independent event catalyst, confidence remains capped.
